filename: National Bridge and Major Culvert Investment Plan FY 2026-27
snippet: National bridge and major culvert condition inventory and maintenance prioritisation programme across 552 bridges and 452 major culverts on the 21,284.02 km National Road Network. Issued 17/11/2026.

filename: National Critical Structures Schedule and Photographic Evidence Register 2026
snippet: Overall and component condition schedules covering 104 critical bridges and 8 critical major culverts across all 6 Maintenance Regions and 23 Maintenance Stations. Issued 17/11/2026.

filename: Kampala - Entebbe Expressway Corridor Structures Assessment 2026
snippet: Detailed structural assessment of 56 expressway structures (overbridges, underbridges, viaducts, and box culverts) along the Busega - Mpala mainline and Munyonyo spur. Inspected 13/05/2026.

filename: National Bridge Inspection and Condition Rating Manual
snippet: Standardised 0 to 9 component condition rating methodology covering Approaches, Waterway, Substructure, Superstructure, and Roadway elements across the National Road Network.
